_comment: The purchased reference report, as a test fixture. Both surfaces are computed from these inputs and their difference from the report is asserted. The report is a benchmark, not market truth: see _referenceIsNotMarketEvidence below.
_source: LandValuePH detailed report LVPH-D-9531904C, dated October 5, 2026. 21 pages; text extracted with pypdf from the file the user supplied.
_sourceLocation: BINAY ST (RESSURRECCION ST), Poblacion III, Bauan
_provenance: Inputs read from report pages 3 (Subject Property Details) and 4 (Building Valuation). Arithmetic reconciled independently in tests/market_benchmarks_node.js and again in tests/value_guide_reference_benchmark_node.js.

reported.birSchedule: BIR RR 8-2018, as cited by the report

derived._note: 1,350,000 / 1,150,000. This is where the guide's MODEL.MARKET_IND comes from - it is read off one report, not derived from market evidence.

_referenceIsNotMarketEvidence: Five internal contradictions, kept here so nobody later cites this report as proof of a real market rate. (1) It claims a +2.0% net adjustment, but the four category rows it prints sum to +0.5%. (2) The +2.0% is never applied to the arithmetic: 1,150,000 x 1.02 = 1,173,000, not the 1,350,000 it reports. (3) Its own tax-visibility page states a market rate of 23,000/sqm (2.0x BIR), inconsistent with the 13,500/sqm it valued the land at. (4) Depreciation is labelled '20.0%/year' but 20% is accumulated over a 40-year life; its remaining-life line says 85% / 34 years, which implies 15%. (5) Page 6 states active market listing data for Bauan is still being compiled and shows no comparables. It is a BIR-referenced AVM, not a market-derived appraisal.
